subject: Marine Works - Vancouver Harbour
text:
Marine Works - Vancouver Harbour
BC Hydro will be installing marker balls on the cable crossing over Burrard Inlet in the vicinity of Barnet Marine Park at 49 17.469N 122 55.064W. Helicopter with workers will be suspended from the aircraft. Mercury Transport water taxi will be on scene directing traffic. 
Hours of operation daily from 1500UTC Oct 19 to 0000 Oct 24.
Vessels on site monitoring VHF Ch. 8, 12, 16.
